# meSpeak third-party notice

The bundled speech synthesizer is meSpeak 2.0.2, based on speak.js/eSpeak.
The upstream package declares the code as GNU GPL (`GPL` in its npm package metadata).

- Upstream: https://github.com/mikolalysenko/mespeak
- npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/mespeak
- Browser bundle: `scripts/vendor/mespeak.min.js`
- Corresponding upstream sources, configuration, and the selected `es-la` voice are kept alongside this notice.

The meSpeak component remains subject to its upstream GNU GPL terms. Its code and data are included separately from the application files.
